title: Brush and broom clearing on a Sooke acreage

seo.title: Sample project: Sooke brush and broom clearing | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: broom and blackberry cleared from a Sooke acreage before seed set, keeping young firs and arbutus.

summary: Scotch broom and blackberry cleared from a rural lot while keeping native trees.
challenge: Scotch broom and blackberry had closed in the driveway and a field on a rural lot.
approach: We checked the brush for active nests first, then cut and pulled the broom before it set seed and cleared the blackberry.
The owners wanted the young Douglas-firs and arbutus kept, so we worked around them. The invasive material was disposed of following CRD guidance.
result: An open driveway and field, with native trees kept.
